original_test_intent: Verify that every Type 16 Physical Memory Array Use enum correctly identifies the array's functional role, corresponds to the intended platform memory topology and linked Type 17 devices, and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete Type 16 and Type 17 records, bind each Use value to its array handle and companion fields, resolve every Type 17 array reference, compare the role-to-device topology with the approved platform map, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected Use role for each array and the reboot plan. The metadata check needs no physical DIMM activity.
required_inputs: Expected Physical Memory Array Use enum per handle or stable array identity
Platform mapping of System Memory, Video Memory, Flash Memory or other supported roles
Type 16-to-Type 17 handle policy including empty arrays/slots
Policy for Unknown, Other and vendor-specific values
Validated dmidecode access and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and OS inventory queries only; do not manipulate DIMMs or memory policy.
Do not inject memory errors, clear logs, update firmware or substitute OS usage labels for the SMBIOS Use enum.
Bind every value to its complete Type 16 record and resolve Type 17 handles before topology judgment.
Report unknown enums and dangling/duplicate links explicitly without guessing.
Stop on topology ambiguity or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse all Type 16 handles and Use values, resolve Type 17 links, compare the approved role map and collect pre/post reboot diffs.
Do not alter memory hardware/configuration, invent enum meanings or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-array Use roles, special-enum handling and the role-to-slot topology.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep -A1 loses array identity, raw enum and Type 17 associations and may mix multiple arrays.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 16 and Type 17 data; report array handle, raw/decoded Use, location, capacity, ECC and each linked device/slot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Use scope, linked Type 16 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing is excluded because it is destructive and unrelated to the metadata field.

modernized_recommendation.status: PER-ARRAY USE ENUM AND LINK VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the raw Use enum for every Type 16 handle, resolve all referencing Type 17 devices, compare the approved functional-role topology and repeat the entire map after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems exposing SMBIOS Type 16 and linked Type 17 records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode and OS inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 16 Use enumeration and Type 17 array-handle semantics, plus the authoritative platform memory architecture.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds record identity, raw-enum checking, complete multi-array coverage and linked-device validation to the isolated decoded string.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects correct-looking roles assigned to the wrong array, unsupported enum values and missing, duplicate or cross-role Type 17 links.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-array Use baseline and platform role/topology map.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS consumers and NUMA nodes may corroborate system memory but cannot define all SMBIOS array roles such as firmware or video memory.

project_override_considerations: A project may define a platform-specific combination of array roles and empty arrays, but must version the decision with stable identities and linked Type 17 topology; it cannot reinterpret a standard enum without documented firmware rationale.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity, per-array Use enum and Type 16/17 role-to-slot map
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16 and Type 17 records
Per-array raw/decoded Use result and resolved device references including gaps/duplicates
Read-only OS inventory clearly labeled as corroboration rather than enum authority
Approved reboot/health evidence and complete post-reboot role/link diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Use field and correctness/persistence criteria align; the absent platform role baseline is a normal project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Structured enum and handle validation are fully automatable after approved inputs; no physical or semantic blocker is intrinsic.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum, per-array identity, complete coverage and Type 17 topology resolution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its topology and safety improvements while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification under locked V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates baseline/reboot approval and engineer verdict from automated metadata validation.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic 'System Memory' string from passing when attached to an unintended array or inconsistent with its linked device set.
independent_technical_reasoning: Use is a finite SMBIOS enum and its record/link context is machine-readable; with an approved topology, comparison and reboot persistence require no manual core action.
